reason: A puts an operable, internally consistent dock artifact (yard clock, door lights, bookable grid) next to the promise in the first screen. It recomposes that artifact for the phone with door tabs, and it never claims a number it doesn't have. B has the stronger voice and dispatcher path, but its board degrades to clipped labels on mobile and it states unmeasured timings as fact. Fixing A's header CTA contrast and the leaked 'ours to confirm with the client' line would raise my confidence. B shedding the unsupported numbers and making its mobile board legible would make this close.
